image_description: Two black loudspeakers positioned side-by-side against a white background. The speaker on the left is angled, showing its front grille and side profile with wheels at the base. The speaker on the right faces forward, displaying a large central woofer cone, a smaller tweeter above it, and a protective metal mesh grille covering the drivers. Both units appear to be professional PA-style monitors with rugged enclosures.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The hexagonal mesh pattern on the right speaker's grille becomes slightly irregular and 'melts' into the background near the top right edge, lacking perfect geometric consistency.
The caster wheel on the bottom left of the left speaker appears partially fused with the enclosure base, lacking a clear axle or separation gap.
The side panel of the left speaker seems to curve inward unnaturally rather than maintaining a straight rigid edge, suggesting slight warping.
